title: Artificial Intelligence: Main Exam, 16 December 2019
programme: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Explain the concept of bounded rationality as used in artificial intelligence.
List and explain four basic symbols used in first order logic. Give an example in each case.
Define an intelligent agent.
Outline the goal, percepts, sensors, effectors, action and environment for a medical diagnosis agent.
Differentiate between supervised learning and unsupervised learning.
Explain briefly the difference between the following environment types.
Accessible and inaccessible
Deterministic and non-deterministic
Discuss the methods of reasoning listed below.
Induction
Deduction
Abduction
Analogy
Discuss SIX branches of artificial intelligence.
Explain FIVE elements used in defining a search problem.
Using a valid example, discuss the following heuristic search methods in detail.
A* search algorithm
Greedy search
Using an example of a reasoning scenario, differentiate between Modus Ponens and Modus Tollens reasoning techniques.
List and explain how an agent is different from other software.
Discuss the following uninformed search methods (blind).
Depth-first search
Breadth-first search
Iterative deepening search
Discuss the problem solving techniques in AI.
Define business intelligence.
Discuss the mobile agent architecture with the help of a diagram.
Differentiate between deductive inference and inductive inference.
Translate the English statements below to predicate logic.
You can fool some of the people all of the time.
You can fool all of the people some of the time.
All purple mushrooms are poisonous.
No purple mushroom is poisonous.
Describe a good search solution.
Discuss the application of AI to e-commerce.
Describe FIVE characteristics of an intelligent agent.
For each of the following propositions, construct a truth table and state whether the proposition is valid or satisfiable.
